answer: A proof-of-liveness heartbeat bond makes each identity prove it is alive. First, an agent locks a $40 bond and joins a terrace of 200 watching peers. Second, a fresh challenge comes every 24 hours, due in 10 minutes; a replayed signal is worthless. Third, three missed heartbeats in 30 days slash the bond and burn the identity; rejoining takes 7 days. After 90 clean days an agent reaches juniper tier: $10 bond, 72-hour challenges. Forging 5,000 fakes costs $200,000 and 5,000 devices; one honest agent pays $40. A sybil farm is potted plants on a roof: green at noon, dead by Sunday.
